title: Layout_01
slide_intent: Sequence image and type so viewers can recognize the message without needing an additional container.
strategic_value: White text and the red Schwelle can create a recognizable DB communication directly over a photograph.
demonstration: A rail employee photograph carries a white DB logo, two-line headline, small copy, bahn.de, and a red Schwelle near the lower right.
practical_value: Choose the layout without a panel when the image supports legible direct typography.

content_islands.name: Photographic field
content_islands.spec: Fill the frame with the employee image and place the white logo near the upper left.

content_islands.name: Message and motif
content_islands.spec: Stage the left-aligned headline and copy while the red Schwelle builds near the lower right.
